Requested by learniq (decision D10, learniq PR #1132 moved the owner to planninq). Covered by planninq's school-timetable-target, in planninq PR #685 (open at 9801e16, not yet on development): its idempotent upsert keyed by sourceSystem and externalRef, the TimetableUpsertRequestedEvent and the admin route POST /api/timetable/sessions/upsert let another system add its own sessions to a group's or a teacher's timetable. A single learner is not addressable on their own. If PR #685 does not merge, this row goes back to none.

Two competitors rate it yes (Xedule 'Concept publiceren', TimeEdit Viewer draft sharing). school-timetable-target has no draft stage: every delivered session is readable at once. The new change adds a draft status readable by the named teacher and admins, drafts only on request, and an admin publish; it depends on planninq PR #685.
